label: Cost Estimate
description: Estimate cost, budget, or pricing impact.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about price, spend, ROI, or budget.

label: Financial Option Comparison
description: Compare cost, budget, pricing, or ROI across options.

classifier.useWhen: User asks which option is more cost-effective or financially practical.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for non-financial technical comparison only.

label: Invoice Review
description: Review invoices, charges, billing details, and anomalies.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to inspect an invoice or bill.

label: Budget Planning
description: Plan budget allocations, constraints, and spend categories.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to plan a budget.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for exact accounting treatment.

label: Financial Forecast
description: Forecast cost, spend, revenue, or usage under assumptions.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for guaranteed financial prediction.

label: Unit Economics
description: Analyze margins, unit costs, payback, or per-user economics.

label: Pricing Model
description: Build or critique pricing structures and assumptions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to price something.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for sales outreach copy only.

label: Variance Analysis
description: Analyze actual vs expected cost, budget, or revenue.

classifier.useWhen: User asks why financial numbers changed.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for vendor feature comparison only.

label: Procurement Cost Analysis
description: Analyze purchasing, vendor, or contract cost implications.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about procurement cost tradeoffs.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal contract approval.

label: ROI Calculation
description: Calculate or estimate return on investment and payback.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for ROI or payback estimate.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for non-financial prioritization only.
